ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Jupiter

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.

t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.
